title: Breadth Is Broken. Smart Money Is Loading Up!
speaker: Arete Trading host

macro_themes.theme: Breadth weak but index at highs
macro_themes.view: S&P breadth is in the 8th percentile while index is near all-time highs; host sees this as a narrow, rotation-driven market similar to 2006, not a crash signal.

macro_themes.theme: Yields 5% not yet a problem for tech
macro_themes.view: 10-year above 5% won't hurt megacap tech until well into the 6s or near 7% given earnings growth; hot PMI (58.4) drives rising rate-hike odds.
Expects a quarter-end rebalance rotation out of software/cybersecurity (IGV) and into semiconductors around Sep 30-Oct 1.
High oil/diesel costs crushing consumer discretionary, retail and utilities; hyperscalers unaffected.

calls.reason: Weekly breakout to new highs in August, successful mid-September retest and bounce on rising volume; setting up to rechallenge highs.
calls.quote: you're really setting up to rechallenge these levels up here

calls.reason: All-time high close on NDX; breadth improving; rate-hike cycle comparable to 1999 when tech still rallied.
calls.quote: you're at an all-time high. And based upon that, when I mark this off, I think we could set up to go higher

calls.reason: Proprietary semiconductor breadth model fired a buy signal Friday; semis breaking out of a triangle; ROIC far above cost of capital for hyperscaler spending; quarter-end rotation into semis.
calls.quote: I've gotten a buy signal here on Friday

calls.reason: Software/cybersecurity names (CRWD, PANW, BUG, CIBR) closing at lows into OPEX; IGV/SOX ratio breaking its channel; expects quarter-end rotation out of software.
calls.quote: I would be a little concerned about software and I'd be afraid of the rotation

calls.condition: Earnings Wednesday; bearish if Micron flags Chinese supply flooding the market
calls.reason: 12/22/55 MAs spreading up, ~6x earnings, strong DRAM prices; expects good earnings though stock has historically faded after earnings pops.
calls.quote: It's my belief that they should have good earnings

calls.reason: Consumer discretionary not participating since August breakout; high diesel/oil costs cannot be passed through (Casey's margin compression, XRT collapse).
calls.quote: XLY since the breakout August 3rd, they're not participating
